priorityList: Ensure your primary pet is summoned before combat starts.
Use your Potion, Power Infusion, and Racial abilities while Summon Demonic Tyrant is active.
Use offensive on-use Trinkets, ideally syncing them with Summon Demonic Tyrant.
Cast Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer stacks of Demonic Core.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan immediately if the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Cast Grimoire: Felguard (or Grimoire: Fel Ravager/Imp Lord) on cooldown.
Summon Demonic Tyrant on cooldown, ensuring major demons (Dreadstalkers, Grimoire) are already active.
Cast Implosion if you have 6 or more Wild Imps and have the 'To Hell and Back' talent active.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan whenever you have 3 or more Soul Shards.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt if you have a Demonic Core proc and fewer than 4 Soul Shards, prioritizing targets without the Doom debuff.
Cast Shadow Bolt as your primary filler to generate Soul Shards.
